scenes.summary: You met Hermann, a UWST Search and Rescue (SAR) crew mate, near the shattered highway. Hermann's SAR mission just encountered a major obstacle.

lines.text: No loitering here! This is a dangerous place!
The name's Hermann. I'm part of the UWST SAR crew. You ... you're the Endministrator!
There was a supplies truck driving on that elevated bridge when the Ankhorfall happened. We received reports that a trucker is trapped up there.
I wanted to reach that place with ropes but soon realized it's way beyond me. So I decided to clean up the wrecked trucks before they become explosive hazards.
My SAR mission is stuck. We're trying to figure something out.
This situation is way beyond non-specialists like us, plus we've been short on hands. Your help is much appreciated, my Endfielder friend.
Yeah, that should work! The tower crane can be used to move the containers, and 2 of them should be enough!
We also just repaired the machinery nearby. Never guessed they would get useful now.

options: Don't panic. I'm an Endfielder. What happened here?
Let me give you a hand. I did my share of demolishing.
Those containers up there can be used to create a path.
Sounds like a plan. I'll try it out.

r: Don't panic. I'm an Endfielder. What happened here?
That's me. What's your sitch?
Let me give you a hand. I did my share of demolishing.
Those containers up there can be used to create a path.
Sounds like a plan. I'll try it out.

lines.text: *Sigh* We're stretched too thin as it is. We can only entrust this matter to you.

scenes.summary: You save UWST trucker Scott and he tells you about the accident. He also asks you to take out the Aggelos.

lines.text: Finally! Someone made it up here!
I'm ... I'm Scott. I'm a UWST trucker.
My ... my truck...
I'm sorry. I really need to take a few deep breaths. Worst day of my life...
Ah! Yeah ... gotta check myself. Am I hurt? I don't think I am...
I'm sorry...
The entire bridge shook and flopped like ... like fettuccine...
Yeah. My mind was totally blank. A giant Aggelos suddenly appeared on the road and buckled the entire bridge. I didn't know what to do...
It was at that moment when some car rammed the back of my truck. I was forced to park it on the side of the road.
Then the Blight rupture took place. It sent me flying out of my truck and knocked me senseless. I woke up and saw that the bridge had been ... destroyed.
Just thinking about this terrible thing gives me the shivers. If I were another yard or two closer, I would be dead for sure.
I don't really ... know...
That driver was trying to pass me and kept flashing the headlights. But I...
Well, he was a piece of work and kept spamming his horn. It was getting on my nerves...
I switched on the radio and told him to act civilized. And he ... well ... yeah ... we went back and forth for quite a while.
When the Aggelos attacked, he rammed my truck and got me out of the way.
*Sigh*... I guess I'll never know.
You're that legendary Endmin everyone's talking about, right? Can I ask you to ... defeat that Aggelos?
That buggerloid stuck around after the disaster. The thought of it still swaggering around the place makes me...
But ... shouldn't we move our trucker to a safe place?
Right, nothing to worry about with the Endmin around.
I'm counting on you! If you can, could you help recover some of the supplies too? It would mean a lot to the team!
But he's...

options: The place is dangerous. Get out of here.
Are you hurt? Let me know.
Take your time. You seem rather unsettled.

r: You alright?
Calm down. You're safe.
Are you hurt? Let me know.
Take your time. You seem rather unsettled.
back
What happened here?
back
The place is dangerous. Get out of here.

lines.text: Thank you, Endmin! I checked on him and he's alright.
He's one lucky bloke...
Scott told me about the Aggelos, so it all made sense now. A Blightflood is quite unlikely to ... break the bridge into three sections.
We would use the collapsible bridge to reach the other side. But I don't know what's wrong. It's not working anymore.
Okay. I saw plenty of supplies on that hillside nearby. There might be backup parts in there. Be careful, though, the friggin' LBs claimed it as their turf.

options: I need to reach that Aggelos and tell it to leave.
Looks like it's missing certain parts.
Don't worry. I'll take a look. Wait here for me.

r: I need to reach that Aggelos and tell it to leave.
Looks like it's missing certain parts.
Don't worry. I'll take a look. Wait here for me.

lines.text: Did you find all the backup parts?
Well, we're still counting on you!

r: Not yet.

lines.text: You did it!
Thank you for everything! Now I can finally go retrieve those supplies.

r: Finally, it's all over.

lines.text: This place is ... really Blighted. We can't risk moving around.

options: Don't worry. I'll figure something out.

r: Don't worry. I'll figure something out.

lines.text: You did it! You ... you smashed the Aggelos!
Thank you so much, Endmin.
This incident really got me thinking. I don't know if the driver was trying to help me, but I ... I think I owe him one.
I'll look for a chance and help someone in need. That'll help pay off the debt.

options: I hope this makes you feel better.

r: I hope this makes you feel better.

lines.text: Really appreciate this, Endmin!
I'm heading to our next SAR mission.
Thank you!
I will! I've still got work ahead helping with the rebuilding!

r: Take care of yourself.
